LanguageData.ROCKET_FuelScaleLabel: Airstrike fuel cost: {0}% of one world-tile flight
LanguageData.ROCKET_HoverFuelDesc: How fast aircraft that stay airborne after a strafing run (Apache) burn fuel. 0% makes hovering free.
LanguageData.ROCKET_StayAirborneDefaultLabel: Stay airborne after strafing by default
LanguageData.ROCKET_StayAirborneDefaultDesc: Default for the "Stay airborne" toggle on aircraft that can hover. Aircraft whose toggle you already changed keep their own setting.
LanguageData.ROCKET_BombDamageDesc: Multiplies the damage (and, with Combat Extended, armor penetration) of every bomb dropped from an aircraft or set off as an IED. Blast radius is unchanged.
LanguageData.ROCKET_ScatterDesc: Multiplies how far bombs and strafing rounds land from their aim point. 0% is pinpoint accurate.
LanguageData.ROCKET_StrafingAmmoDesc: Multiplies the ammunition a strafing run takes from cargo. 0% makes strafing free.
LanguageData.ROCKET_AllowNuclearDesc: When off, nuclear bombs (URDAM, tactical nuke) can't be selected or dropped.
LanguageData.ROCKET_WPLingeringDesc: When off, white phosphorus bombs only explode and set fires; they don't leave lingering burning phosphorus on the ground.
LanguageData.ROCKET_DebugTabBlurb: Diagnostic overlays for tuning flight paths and waypoint placement. Most players can leave these off.
LanguageData.ROCKET_DebugDrawFlightPathDesc: While a multi-target sortie is in the air, draw the spline path it follows as a polyline on the map. Useful for tuning curve tension and waypoint placement.
LanguageData.ROCKET_SingleStrikeDesc: Make a single bombing pass over a chosen cell, dropping one round.
LanguageData.ROCKET_BombingRunDesc: Make a bombing pass dropping {0} rounds along a chosen line.
LanguageData.ROCKET_StrafingRunDesc: Strafe a chosen line with {3}. Fires {0} rounds, consuming {1} {2} from cargo. Switch weapons in the Payload tab.
LanguageData.ROCKET_LocalFlightDesc: Ferry the vehicle to a chosen cell on this map. Rises in place, transits at altitude, and descends at the destination.
LanguageData.ROCKET_HoldShiftMultiTarget: Hold SHIFT to select multiple targets
LanguageData.ROCKET_PreparedRunwayFailure: Prepared runway required: {0} cells under the takeoff strip aren't suitable ({1}).
LanguageData.ROCKET_PreparedRunwayFailure_OutOfBounds: Prepared runway required: runway strip extends off the map.
LanguageData.ROCKET_RunwayInfo_RequiresHeavy_Desc: If Yes, this vehicle can only take off and land from terrain that supports heavy construction (Concrete, Paved Tile, Metal Tile, Sterile Tile, and most modded industrial floors). Any terrain in the excluded list still disqualifies regardless.
LanguageData.ROCKET_RunwayInfo_RequiredTerrain_Desc: Additional terrain types that qualify as runway, even if they would otherwise not be eligible.
LanguageData.ROCKET_RunwayInfo_ExcludedTerrain_Desc: Terrain and floor families that disqualify a cell as runway, even if they would otherwise be eligible.
LanguageData.ROCKET_StayAirborneDesc: When on, the aircraft keeps hovering over the battlefield after a strafing run instead of landing. Select it in the air to order more runs, switch weapons or land. It burns fuel while airborne and lands by itself when the tank runs dry.
LanguageData.ROCKET_LoiterStarted: {0} is holding position in the air. Select it to order another run or to land.
LanguageData.ROCKET_LoiterOutOfFuel: {0} is out of fuel and is making an emergency landing.
LanguageData.ROCKET_LandAtDesc: Pick a spot and land there.
LanguageData.ROCKET_LandHereDesc: Set down at the nearest clear spot below the aircraft.
LanguageData.ROCKET_ReturnToPadDesc: Fly back and land where the aircraft originally took off.
LanguageData.ROCKET_NotWhileInFlight: Not available while the aircraft is in flight. Wait until it is hovering or has landed.
LanguageData.ROCKET_SwitchWeaponDesc: Switch the strafing weapon used for the next run.
LanguageData.ROCKET_IEDDetonateDesc: Set off this IED now. It explodes like a {0} dropped from the air. Select several IEDs to detonate them together.
LanguageData.ROCKET_IEDNuclearDisabled: Nuclear weapons are disabled in the mod settings.
